name: coach_imported_review_source_fk
definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_review_id) REFERENCES "Learner".reviews(id) NOT VALID

name: learner_activity_sources_catalog_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_catalog_activity_id) REFERENCES curriculum.source_activities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL NOT VALID

name: learner_journal_rows_month_check
definition: CHECK (month ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$'::text) NOT VALID

name: learner_progress_actual_seconds_nonnegative
definition: CHECK (actual_seconds IS NULL OR actual_seconds >= 0) NOT VALID

name: learner_progress_reporting_interval_valid
definition: CHECK (reporting_started_at IS NULL OR reporting_ended_at IS NULL OR reporting_ended_at >= reporting_started_at) NOT VALID

name: learner_progress_sync_run_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (sync_run_id) REFERENCES "Learner".activity_sync_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL NOT VALID

name: learner_progress_ksbs_no_json_tokens
definition: CHECK (btrim(ksb_code::text) <> ALL (ARRAY['['::text, ']'::text, '{'::text, '}'::text, '"'::text, chr(39), ','::text, chr(92), '[]'::text, '{}'::text])) NOT VALID

name: cohorts_programme_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (programme_id) REFERENCES curriculum.programmes(programme_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID

name: chk_authoring_component_otjh_nonnegative
definition: CHECK (expected_otjh >= 0::numeric) NOT VALID

name: chk_authoring_component_points_nonnegative
definition: CHECK (points >= 0) NOT VALID

name: groups_programme_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (programme_id) REFERENCES curriculum.programmes(programme_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID

name: source_activities_material_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_material_id) REFERENCES curriculum.source_materials(material_id) ON DELETE SET NULL NOT VALID

name: source_planned_bulk_items_journal_row_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (journal_row_id) REFERENCES "Learner".learner_journal_rows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL NOT VALID

name: week_templates_programme_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (programme_id) REFERENCES curriculum.programmes(programme_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID

name: chk_authoring_week_order_nonnegative
definition: CHECK (display_order >= 0 AND week_number >= 1) NOT VALID

name: assignment_classification_evaluations_run_learner_fk
definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id, learner_id) REFERENCES fetching_evidence.assignment_classification_runs(id, learner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID

name: assignment_classification_evaluations_score_classification_chec
definition: CHECK (final_score >= 85 AND final_score <= 100 AND classification = 'Exceptional'::text OR final_score >= 70 AND final_score <= 84 AND classification = 'Strong'::text OR final_score >= 55 AND final_score <= 69 AND classification = 'Acceptable'::text OR final_score >= 40 AND final_score <= 54 AND classification = 'Needs improvement'::text OR final_score >= 0 AND final_score <= 39 AND classification = 'Unsuitable'::text) NOT VALID

name: assignment_classification_evaluations_selected_excluded_check
definition: CHECK (NOT (selected AND excluded)) NOT VALID

name: assignment_classification_results_evaluation_fk
definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id, component_id) REFERENCES fetching_evidence.assignment_classification_evaluations(run_id, component_id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID

name: assignment_classification_results_run_learner_fk
definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id, learner_id) REFERENCES fetching_evidence.assignment_classification_runs(id, learner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID

name: assignment_classification_results_score_classification_check
definition: CHECK (final_score >= 85 AND final_score <= 100 AND classification = 'Exceptional'::text OR final_score >= 70 AND final_score <= 84 AND classification = 'Strong'::text OR final_score >= 55 AND final_score <= 69 AND classification = 'Acceptable'::text OR final_score >= 40 AND final_score <= 54 AND classification = 'Needs improvement'::text OR final_score >= 0 AND final_score <= 39 AND classification = 'Unsuitable'::text) NOT VALID

name: assignment_classification_runs_job_count_nonnegative
definition: CHECK (job_count >= 0) NOT VALID
